name: browser-cli
description: Browser CLI that controls Chrome through a local extension bridge

scripts.check:extension: node --check extension/service-worker.js && node --check extension/browser-boundaries.js && node --check extension/close-idle.js && node --check extension/runtime-state.js
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run check:extension
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run check && npm test && npm run build
